introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: Answer ALL the questions in the spaces provided (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: All questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown: Using a scale of 1 cm to represent 1 unit on each axis, for $0\leq x\leq9$ and $0\leq y\leq10$
incertitudes: Q B4 : triangles à tracer par l'élève ; le corrigé donne les points clés. L'image par la réflexion dans l'axe des y (x négatif) sort de l'intervalle d'axes imprimé 0 <= x <= 9 : signalé dans le corrigé de (d). Aucun barème par sous-question imprimé.

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Draw and label triangle XYZ with coordinates $X(3,2)$, $Y(6,2)$ and $Z(6,5)$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Draw $x$ from $0$ to $9$ and $y$ from $0$ to $10$ with 1 cm per unit. Plot $X(3,2)$, $Y(6,2)$, $Z(6,5)$ and join them, labelling the vertices.

The triangle is right-angled at $Y$: $XY=3$ units (horizontal) and $YZ=3$ units (vertical).

questions.enonce_markdown:
The transformation T is a translation that maps triangle XYZ to $X'Y'Z'$, where $T=\begin{pmatrix}3\\4\end{pmatrix}$

(b) Find the coordinates of $X'Y'Z'$

questions.corrige_markdown: Plot $X'(6,6)$, $Y'(9,6)$ and $Z'(9,9)$ on the same axes and join them. The triangle is congruent to $XYZ$ (same size and orientation), moved 3 units right and 4 units up. All its points lie inside the given grid ($x\leq9$, $y\leq10$).

questions.enonce_markdown: (d) Reflect triangle XYZ on the $y$-axis to give $X''Y''Z''$
questions.corrige_markdown:
Reflection in the $y$-axis: $(x,y)\mapsto(-x,y)$.

Plot $X''(-3,2)$, $Y''(-6,2)$, $Z''(-6,5)$ and join them. This image is the mirror image of $XYZ$ in the $y$-axis, on the left of the axis (extend the $x$-axis to $-6$ for this part).

questions.enonce_markdown: (e) Write down the coordinates of $X''Y''Z''$ *[15 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Change the sign of each $x$-coordinate and keep the $y$-coordinate:

$X''=(-3,2)$, $Y''=(-6,2)$, $Z''=(-6,5)$.
